verdict.rationale: Mailgun publishes an API reference section and a public Postman workspace with organized collections, examples, environment variables and ready-to-use requests. That gives runnable examples, but only through an external tool (Postman) rather than an interactive in-docs reference, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the common paths. Missing for 10: an in-browser interactive 'try it' API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
